reuse.why: Fintegra reuses findOrCreateBank and linkBankSyncAccount, and all six providers share the new validation helper, but replacement duplicates the existing local unlink operation.

duplication.why: The change duplicates unlinkAccount's field-clearing block and the existing transaction download request, error handling, and response mapping.

placement.why: Provider adapters, configuration, and types follow existing layers, although local unlink mutation belongs in a shared operation rather than an assertion helper.

scope.why: The edits are focused on the requested linking rules, replacement option, Fintegra integration, and associated tests.

maintainability.why: Shared linking remains intact, but a mutating assertion, duplicated unlink fields, and validation calls maintained separately across six adapters make future changes harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked directly reproduces unlinkAccount's local cleanup to avoid its provider side effects instead of extracting a shared local unlink operation.

disguised_duplication.where: sync.ts: downloadFintegraTransactions reproduces downloadEnableBankingTransactions with renamed provider references and the aspspName argument removed.

abstraction_drift.where: app.ts: assertBankAccountNotLinked accumulates closed-target rejection and replacement handling, adds replaceExistingLink, and changes from validation into mutation; all six provider link handlers call it.
